text:
anya: quick thread with results from the GPTQ sweep we ran overnight across Llama-2-13B, Mistral-7B-v0.1, and Qwen-7B. pulling out the actionable bits (accuracy deltas, perf, and recommended deploy profiles).

mikhail: nice — do you have a short summary first? can skim then dig into per-layer logs if needed.

anya: TL;DR: GPTQ (per-channel, act-order) gives ~1.0–1.6% relative drop on reasoning benchmarks for Llama-2‑13B at 4-bit GPTQ configs; Mistral shows slightly larger deltas (~1.8–2.4%) in zero-shot math/lang tasks; Qwen is the most robust to GPTQ here (0.2–0.9% deltas). AWQ variants recovered ~0.3–0.6% vs GPTQ on average but cost slightly more tokens/time. INT8 (symmetric) looked ok for Mistral for throughput-focused workloads but had some edge-case decode hallucinations on code evals.

jess: quick numbers snapshot (eval mean deltas vs FP16 baseline):
MMLU: Llama-2-13B GPTQ4: -1.1% | Mistral-7B GPTQ4: -2.0% | Qwen-7B GPTQ4: -0.6%
HumanEval (pass@1): Llama: -1.4pp | Mistral: -2.8pp | Qwen: -0.5pp
Reasoning (GSM8K): Llama: -1.6 | Mistral: -2.3 | Qwen: -0.9

sam: thanks — what about latency and mem? any weird kv-cache regressions?

anya: latency (single-stream, p99) on A100: FP16 Llama-13B: 180ms, GPTQ4: 145ms (good), AWQ: 150ms. Memory reduction ~35–45% depending on per-layer clipping. For Mistral we saw better memory gains (40–50%) but slightly worse accuracy impact. KV-cache behavior: one notable pattern — layer 2 outliers on Mistral when using per-tensor scales (leads to decode artifacts). we flagged per-channel as default for Mistral.

mikhail: any config snippets you want to lock in for deploy experiments?

anya: suggested defaults for a staged rollout:
```
quant_backend: gptq
bitwidth: 4
granularity: per-channel
act_order: true
clip_threshold: 3.0
fallback_policy: roll-to-int8-on-regression
```
Hosted (low-latency) profile: enable AWQ fallback for Llama and Qwen; Dedicated (high-throughput) profile: GPTQ4 with batched decoding and larger KV-sharding. Private: recommend experimenting with INT8 symmetric for Mistral if customers accept slightly higher accuracy risk in exchange for halving cost.

jess: nice, how did AWQ compare on edge cases?

anya: AWQ recovered ~0.3% on MMLU and ~0.2pp on HumanEval vs GPTQ across the three models, but AWQ inference kernels increase per-token CPU overhead on our current runtime — observed 6–9% higher p95 latency vs GPTQ on the same GPU in our tests. AWQ also seems more stable on Mistral layer outliers.

sam: rollouts/monitors — what thresholds should trigger rollback?

anya: propose these automatic rollback triggers for canary->prod:
- MMLU drop > 1.5% absolute vs baseline on canary promptset
- HumanEval pass@1 drop > 1.0pp on code evalset
- New 5xx/error rate increase > 0.5% or p95 latency increase > 15%
- Any user-reported hallucination spike detected by our quality-monitoring classifier
If any trigger fires, auto-fallback to previous quant profile and notify #eng-ml + SE team.

mikhail: did you run per-layer quant error heatmaps? want to see which layers to prioritize for mixed precision?

anya: yes — high-level: Llama-13B head & early feedforward layers are most sensitive, so mixed precision (keep those layers at 8-bit or fp16) cuts most of the accuracy loss while keeping ~25–30% memory savings. For Mistral, mid-block attention QK layers are sensitive; for Qwen fewer hotspots, so Qwen is a good candidate for pure GPTQ4. I'll upload detailed heatmaps to the run id: r-2026-03-gptq-sweep (link in our run dashboard).

jess: any surprising regressions we should call out?

anya: two small ones:
1) Llama-13B GPTQ4 occasionally hallucinated facts in long-context summarization (we traced to quantized positional bias accumulation). mitigation: preserve positional-bias layers in 8-bit.
2) Qwen-7B AWQ had a tiny codegen logical bug in early decodes for very short prompts — reproducible but rare; flagged to AWQ owners, patch in next AWQ release.

deploy-bot: deploy check completed for r-2026-03-gptq-sweep: 12 experiments passed infra checks, 3 failed due to OOM on test fixtures.

sam: final ask — recommended starter profiles for each model to push to dedicated canary?

anya: yes — short:
- Llama-2-13B: GPTQ4 (per-channel) with mixed-precision keep-layers=[pos-bias, ff1] + AWQ fallback for hosted.
- Mistral-7B-v0.1: GPTQ4 per-channel but keep attention QK at 8-bit; consider INT8 symmetric for throughput-only private tenants.
- Qwen-7B: GPTQ4 per-channel default; AWQ if you need extra accuracy and can accept ~7% latency hit.

jess: perfect. I'll create the canary rollout config and add the promptsets for MMLU + HumanEval + our production prompt sampling.

mikhail: thumbs up. if you push the canary, notify infra and SEs. happy to review the roll logs.

anya: will do — saving the run metadata under r-2026-03-gptq-sweep and kicking off canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC. ping me for access. :rocket:
